bibl.title: Ostraca and Postcards. Secrets in Private Letters Written on Ostraca from Egypt.
bibl.seg: Nikos Litinas, Ostraca and Postcards. Secrets in Private Letters Written on Ostraca from Egypt.
Philia. International Journal of Ancient Mediterranean Studies 6 (2020) pp. 93-98.
bibl.note: The inclusion of a secret sign as a clue which enables the recipient of a private letter to identify the sender was one of the ways of authentication. This is easily understandable when the sign is written on a folded and sealed papyrus. It could be used on ostraca too, particularly when these were put in containers in order to secure both the ostraca and the message.
